row: Specialty Purebred Cat Rescue is a foster-based cat rescue located in the Midwest that specializes in finding homes for abandoned and surrendered purebred cats as well as special needs domestic cats.  We are the only all breed purebred rescue in the Midwest.  On our channel we feature videos on how to care for purebred cats, showcase adoptable kitties and provide sneak peaks of cats which will soon be available for adoption.
